clue.text: Diagram, old, found in Cadiz in tatters

something in tatters is torn apart, so the letters of the Spanish port are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: An old chart or plan turns up, torn to shreds, in the Spanish port of Cadiz.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in tatters' scrambles CADIZ to ZDIAC, and 'found in' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The zodiac is the circular astrological chart of the twelve star signs, a kind of diagram.

clue.text: Beat unconscious in the same way

parts.note: a boxer knocked out cold is out
do is short for ditto, meaning likewise or the same again

explanation.surface: A fighter knocks a rival out cold, just as before.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat someone is to surpass or better them, a synonym.

clue.text: Rough Irish customer who's a frequent visitor

parts.note: a pub's regular is the customer who comes in all the time

explanation.surface: A tough Irishman who is always propping up the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough surface is uneven, not smooth or even: a synonym.

clue.text: Ape Greek character, Member of Parliament

parts.note: chi is the Greek letter X

explanation.surface: Someone mimics a Greek MP's mannerisms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ape' reads as a verb, mimic, but it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A chimpanzee is one of the great apes, an example of the class.

clue.text: Recommend short video as training

indicators.note: training reshapes something, so the letters are worked into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written before it is shortened
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims VIDEO to VIDE; with AS, 'training' rearranges VIDEAS.
explanation.definitionFit: To advise a course of action is to recommend it, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Soldier brought in suitable American equipment

parts.note: apt means suitable

explanation.surface: A soldier is drafted in with the right American kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparatus is the gear or machinery needed for a task: a synonym.

clue.text: Corrupting influence in Rugby Union, in Six Nations, ultimately

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word Nations

explanation.surface: Something rotten in rugby, felt in the Six Nations tournament in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: The Six Nations is the annual European rugby union championship.
explanation.definitionFit: A virus, figuratively, is a harmful influence that spreads and corrupts, as in a computer virus.

clue.text: Extraordinary bird circling top of tree

indicators.note: circling means the bird goes round the other letter

parts.note: a starling is a common songbird

indicators.note: top of in a down clue picks the first letter of the word tree

explanation.surface: An amazing bird flies around the top of a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Startling means surprising or remarkable, close in sense to extraordinary.

clue.text: Collected and given a lift

definitions.meaning: money collected for charity has been gathered or brought in
something lifted up has been elevated

explanation.surface: Someone was picked up and driven somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Funds that are collected have been gathered; anything hoisted upwards has been lifted.

clue.text: Member of crew in river passing through English city

indicators.note: passing through puts the river letter inside the city

parts.note: Stoke-on-Trent, often just Stoke, is a city in Staffordshire

explanation.surface: A boat's crew member travels upriver through an English city.
explanation.walkthrough: STOKE is Stoke-on-Trent, an English city in the Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: In rowing, the stroke is the oarsman nearest the stern who sets the pace for the crew.

clue.text: Flower festival failing to open

indicators.note: failing to open means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: Easter is the Christian spring festival

explanation.definitionFit: The aster is a daisy-like garden plant, an example of a flower.

clue.text: To bring in social worker is significant

parts.note: to import goods is to bring them into a country
the ant is the classic worker insect living in colonies

explanation.surface: Hiring a social worker is a big step.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' suggests a care professional; it is an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Important things matter a great deal, a synonym of significant.

clue.text: Makeshift bar opening

parts.note: to bar is to stop or block
a gap is an opening

explanation.surface: A temporary barrier to fill a hole.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopgap is a temporary substitute, so used adjectivally it means improvised.

clue.text: German male teacher sent back rice dish

indicators.note: sent back means the two pieces are read in reverse

parts.note: Otto is a typical German man's name
pupils address a male teacher as sir

explanation.surface: A German man and a teacher return a rice dish to the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is an Italian dish of rice cooked slowly in stock.

clue.text: Abbott and Costello, perhaps — each initially wearing old jacket

indicators.note: wearing means the initials are covered by the garment, so they go inside it

parts.note: a doublet is a close-fitting jacket worn in Tudor times

indicators.note: each initially takes the first letter of both comedians' names

explanation.surface: The comedy pair, each dressed in an old-fashioned jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: The names serve twice: as the definition and, via 'each initially', for A and C put inside DOUBLET.
explanation.definitionFit: Abbott and Costello were an American comedy duo, an example of a two-person comic partnership.

clue.text: Stress column must support two foreign articles

indicators.note: in a down clue, the column goes below and props up the articles

der is the German definite article
a column of figures is a line

explanation.surface: Pressure on a column that has to hold up a couple of foreign pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To underline a point is to emphasise it, the same sense as stress.

clue.text: Prosecutor up calling for confession

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: DA is a District Attorney, an American prosecutor
a mission is a vocation or calling

explanation.surface: A prosecutor stands up to call for a confession.
explanation.definitionFit: An admission is an acknowledgement of guilt, a synonym of confession.

clue.text: Express views in shop, in error

indicators.note: the first in says the answer lies within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A customer speaks their mind in a shop, wrongly.
explanation.definitionFit: To opine is to state an opinion, which is to voice one's views.

clue.text: Undertaking surgery

definitions.meaning: a surgical procedure carried out on a patient

explanation.definitionFit: A big military or business enterprise is called this, and so is a surgeon's procedure.

clue.text: Attacker overlooking a cyclist

indicators.note: overlooking means the letter is ignored and taken out

parts.note: a raider is one who attacks

explanation.surface: An assailant fails to notice a person on a bike.
explanation.definitionFit: A cyclist is someone who rides a bike, so a rider in that context.

clue.text: Say no to mostly red safety device

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: taken as written before trimming
a fuse is an electrical safety device that breaks a circuit

explanation.surface: Turning down a largely red fuse box.
explanation.definitionFit: To refuse is to decline, the same as saying no.

clue.text: Courier in canteen plastered green

parts.note: a mess is a military dining hall

indicators.note: plastered means drunk, so the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A messenger in the canteen is daubed with green paint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plastered' looks like coated, but means drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: A courier carries messages or parcels, which is what a messenger does.

clue.text: Nonsense at end of conference is spin

parts.note: rot means rubbish or nonsense

indicators.note: end of takes the final letter of the word conference

explanation.surface: Political spin is just rubbish at the close of a party conference.
explanation.definitionFit: To rotate is to turn round, the physical sense of spin.

clue.text: In a long time, searches

definitions.meaning: ... means for a very long while
hunts about for food or supplies

explanation.surface: Someone hunts about for what feels like forever.
explanation.definitionFit: Split in two, the letters give the phrase meaning for a long while; whole, they mean hunts for provisions.

clue.text: Boss has no right to make blunder

indicators.note: has no means the following letter is removed

parts.note: a gaffer is a foreman or boss

explanation.surface: The boss, out of his rights, makes a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaffe is a social blunder or embarrassing slip.

clue.text: Monk, say, needs paints I ordered

indicators.note: ordered means put into order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written as fodder
taken as written as fodder

explanation.surface: A monk needs the paints that were ordered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Monk' suggests a friar; it is Thelonious Monk, the jazz pianist.
explanation.definitionFit: Thelonious Monk was a celebrated jazz pianist, so he is an example of a keyboard player.

clue.text: Throw it in front of parish church

indicators.note: in front of places the word it before the church abbreviation

parts.note: P is an abbreviation for parish

explanation.surface: Someone tosses something in front of the parish church.
explanation.definitionFit: To pitch a ball is to throw it, as in baseball or cricket.

clue.text: Model and I do business

parts.note: to deal is to trade or do business

explanation.surface: A model announces that she and I are doing business.
explanation.definitionFit: A model as an adjective is a perfect example, so an ideal is the perfect standard.

clue.text: Miser in family in small Welsh town

indicators.note: the second in places the relatives within the other letters

parts.note: Flint is a town in north-east Wales
kin are one's relatives

explanation.surface: A tight-fisted man lives among relatives in a little Welsh town.
explanation.walkthrough: FLINT is a town in north Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: A skinflint is a mean, stingy person, the same as a miser.

clue.text: Unsuitable at home, exotic pet

parts.note: someone at home is in

indicators.note: exotic suggests something strange or different, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An exotic pet at home is not a good idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Inept means clumsy or unfit for the purpose, near in sense to unsuitable.

clue.text: At any point within banks of salmon river

indicators.note: within puts that word inside the outside letters
banks of picks the outer letters of the word salmon, as banks enclose a river

parts.note: ever means at any time

explanation.surface: Salmon can be found on the banks of the river at any time.
explanation.definitionFit: The Severn is Britain's longest river, flowing from Wales through England.

clue.text: Name of husband meeting with the Parisian

indicators.note: meeting joins the pieces side by side in order

parts.note: and means together with
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A husband's name is linked to a French title.
explanation.definitionFit: A handle is slang for a name or nickname, as in a radio or online handle.
